product_search_500mljy.sql:
SELECT p.id,v.data FROM products p JOIN catalog_products v ON v.id=p.id
    WHERE ($1::uuid IS NULL OR p.id>$1::uuid) AND ($2::boolean OR p.active)
    AND ($3='' OR p.name ILIKE $4 OR p.code ILIKE $4 OR p.effective_mnemonic ILIKE $4
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_barcodes b WHERE b.product_id=p.id AND b.barcode_value ILIKE $4))
    ORDER BY p.id LIMIT $5

customer_order_page.sql: SELECT o.id FROM sales_orders o JOIN order_revisions r ON r.id=o.current_revision_id WHERE ($1::uuid IS NULL OR o.id>$1) AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR o.customer_id=$2) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR o.status=$3) AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR o.confirmed_at>=$4) AND ($5::timestamptz IS NULL OR o.confirmed_at<$5) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR position(lower($6) IN lower(o.order_no || ' ' || (r.address_snapshot->>'customerName')))>0) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT $7
SELECT * FROM order_revisions WHERE id=$1 AND order_id=$2
SELECT * FROM revision_lines WHERE revision_id=$1 ORDER BY position
SELECT COALESCE(sum(l.return_amount),0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS amount FROM sales_returns r JOIN return_lines l ON l.return_id=r.id WHERE r.order_id=$1 AND r.status='confirmed'
SELECT status FROM print_jobs WHERE order_id=$1 AND order_revision_id=$2 ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT customer_id,status FROM sales_orders WHERE id=$1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_signed),0) AS amount FROM customer_ledger_entries WHERE order_id=$1 AND customer_id=$2 AND category IN ('sale','return')

SELECT a.id,a.source_ledger_entry_id,a.target_order_id,a.target_refund_id,
      a.amount-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM settlement_allocations r WHERE r.reverses_allocation_id=a.id),0) AS remaining
    FROM settlement_allocations a WHERE a.customer_id=$1 AND a.kind='allocate'
      AND a.amount>COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM settlement_allocations r WHERE r.reverses_allocation_id=a.id),0)
    ORDER BY a.recorded_at DESC,a.id DESC

inventory_batches.sql: SELECT t.id::text AS cursor_key,v.data FROM inventory_batches t JOIN inventory_batch_data v ON v.id=t.id WHERE t.warehouse_id=$1 AND t.product_id=$2 AND t.remaining_quantity_base>0 ORDER BY t.id LIMIT $3

customer_ledger_page.sql: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE id=$1

SELECT *,to_char(recorded_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS cursor_at FROM customer_ledger_entries WHERE customer_id=$1
    AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR effective_at>=$2) AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR effective_at<$3)
    AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR (recorded_at,id)>($4::timestamptz,$5::uuid)) ORDER BY recorded_at,id LIMIT $6

historical_price.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id,o.confirmed_at,r.id AS revision_id,l.* FROM sales_orders o JOIN order_revisions r ON r.id=o.current_revision_id JOIN revision_lines l ON l.revision_id=r.id WHERE o.customer_id=$1 AND o.status='confirmed' AND l.product_id=$2 AND l.unit_id=$3 AND l.kind<>'return_history' AND l.quantity_base>l.returned_quantity_base ORDER BY o.confirmed_at DESC,o.id DESC,l.position DESC,l.id DESC LIMIT 1

monthly_statement.sql: SELECT id FROM customers WHERE id=$1
SELECT customer_id FROM customer_accounts WHERE customer_id=$1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM customer_ledger_entries WHERE customer_id=$1 AND effective_at<$2 ORDER BY effective_at,recorded_at,id

report_sales_30_days.sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','sale','orderId',o.id,'at',o.confirmed_at,'customerId',o.customer_id,'customerName',c.name,
 'productId',l.product_id,'productName',p.name,'baseUnitName',u.name,'warehouseId',l.warehouse_id,'quantityBase',l.quantity_base,'amount',l.net_amount::text,'costAmount',l.cost_amount::text) AS fact,
 r.id AS revision_id,r.revision_no,r.created_at,o.id AS order_id
 FROM sales_orders o JOIN order_revisions r ON r.id=o.current_revision_id JOIN revision_lines l ON l.revision_id=r.id
 JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id=l.product_id JOIN product_units u ON u.id=p.base_unit_id
 WHERE o.status='confirmed' AND o.confirmed_at>=$4 AND o.confirmed_at<$5
 AND ($1::uuid[] IS NULL OR o.customer_id=ANY($1)) AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR l.product_id=ANY($2)) AND ($3::uuid[] IS NULL OR l.warehouse_id=ANY($3)) ORDER BY o.id,l.position LIMIT $6

SELECT jsonb_build_object('kind','return','orderId',o.id,'at',r.confirmed_at,'customerId',o.customer_id,'customerName',c.name,
 'productId',l.product_id,'productName',p.name,'baseUnitName',u.name,'warehouseId',l.warehouse_id,'quantityBase',rl.quantity_base,'amount',rl.return_amount::text,'costAmount',rl.cost_credit_amount::text) AS fact,
 r.id,r.version,r.recorded_at FROM sales_returns r JOIN sales_orders o ON o.id=r.order_id JOIN return_lines rl ON rl.return_id=r.id JOIN revision_lines l ON l.id=rl.source_revision_line_id
 JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id=l.product_id JOIN product_units u ON u.id=p.base_unit_id
 WHERE r.status='confirmed' AND o.status='confirmed' AND r.confirmed_at>=$4 AND r.confirmed_at<$5
 AND ($1::uuid[] IS NULL OR o.customer_id=ANY($1)) AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR l.product_id=ANY($2)) AND ($3::uuid[] IS NULL OR l.warehouse_id=ANY($3)) ORDER BY r.id,rl.id LIMIT $6

Plans.Filter: ((confirmed_at >= '2026-10-12 09:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone) AND (confirmed_at < '2026-11-11 09:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone) AND (status = 'confirmed'::text))

SELECT jsonb_build_object('eventId',e.id,'customerId',e.customer_id,'customerName',c.name,'kind',e.kind,'amount',e.amount::text,'occurredAt',e.occurred_at,'recordedAt',e.recorded_at,'method',e.method) AS data,e.version
 FROM cash_events e JOIN customers c ON c.id=e.customer_id WHERE e.status='active' AND e.occurred_at>=$1 AND e.occurred_at<$2 AND ($3::uuid[] IS NULL OR e.customer_id=ANY($3)) ORDER BY e.occurred_at,e.id LIMIT $4

Plans.Recheck Cond: ((occurred_at >= '2026-10-12 09:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone) AND (occurred_at < '2026-11-11 09:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone))

report_customer_balances.sql:
SELECT c.id,c.name,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(e.amount_signed) FROM customer_ledger_entries e WHERE e.customer_id=c.id AND e.effective_at<=$1),0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS net,
 (1+(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_ledger_entries e WHERE e.customer_id=c.id AND e.effective_at<=$1))::text AS version,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(-e.amount_signed-COALESCE((SELECT sum(CASE WHEN a.kind='allocate' THEN a.amount ELSE -a.amount END) FROM settlement_allocations a WHERE a.source_ledger_entry_id=e.id AND a.recorded_at<=$1),0))
 FROM customer_ledger_entries e WHERE e.customer_id=c.id AND e.effective_at<=$1 AND e.kind IN ('receipt','opening') AND e.amount_signed<0
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_ledger_entries r WHERE r.reverses_id=e.id AND r.effective_at<=$1)),0)::numeric(20,2)::text AS unallocated
 FROM customers c WHERE ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR c.id=ANY($2)) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT $3
SELECT id,customer_id,recorded_at,source_version FROM customer_ledger_entries WHERE effective_at<=$1 AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR customer_id=ANY($2)) ORDER BY id LIMIT $3

report_inventory.sql:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('productId',p.id,'productName',p.name,'warehouseId',w.id,'warehouseName',w.name,'batchId',b.id,'baseUnitName',u.name,'quantityBase',SUM(m.quantity_delta_base),'costAmount',SUM(m.cost_delta_amount)::numeric(20,2)::text,'receivedAt',b.received_at,'recordedAt',b.recorded_at) AS data
 FROM stock_movements m JOIN inventory_batches b ON b.id=m.batch_id JOIN products p ON p.id=m.product_id JOIN product_units u ON u.id=p.base_unit_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=m.warehouse_id
 WHERE m.recorded_at<=$1 AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.product_id=ANY($2)) AND ($3::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.warehouse_id=ANY($3)) AND ($4::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.batch_id=ANY($4)) GROUP BY b.id,p.id,u.name,w.id ORDER BY p.id,w.id,b.id LIMIT $5

SELECT DISTINCT b.id,b.product_id,b.warehouse_id,b.recorded_at,b.version FROM inventory_batches b JOIN stock_movements m ON m.batch_id=b.id WHERE m.recorded_at<=$1 AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.product_id=ANY($2)) AND ($3::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.warehouse_id=ANY($3)) AND ($4::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.batch_id=ANY($4)) ORDER BY b.id LIMIT $5
